attempts.summary: Configured a shared L2 data segment (192.168.50.0/24) across node1 (eth1), node2 (enp8s0), and node3 (enp8s0), confirmed baseline full-mesh reachability, then applied host-based port isolation (firewalld persistent rich rules dropping traffic from each other's peer IP) on node2 and node3 so they cannot reach each other directly while both retain full reachability to node1. Configuration was made persistent (SONiC /etc/network/interfaces.d/eth1, NetworkManager static profiles, firewalld --permanent rules). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot_id and full post-reboot recovery of addressing, containers/services, and the isolation policy on each.
